profile: Existing owned 3-second mono AAC-LC LOAS/LATM fixture, same complete float32 PCM output
baseline: Fresh host FFmpeg process decodes original LATM to float32 PCM
candidate: Restricted byte-shift LATM unwrap in Python then fresh same FFmpeg process decodes ADTS from stdin
correctness_first: All PCM bytes exact; optimized output equals existing bitwise parser; truncated/bad-sync/missing-config reject
sampling: 2 unreported warmup pairs then 9 recorded pairs, baseline/candidate order alternates; OS caches warm, fresh FFmpeg process per sample
metric: median end-to-end wall seconds including unwrap, child spawn, input/output pipes and teardown
threshold: candidate median <= 1.10 * baseline median; otherwise reject measured Python/host cost profile, not browser-route feasibility
included_costs: all compressed input and PCM transfers
secondary: unwrap-only wall time, output bytes; not CPU or peak-memory claims
